customisationOptions.option: Add Nefertari's tomb on request (extra fee, permit)
customisationOptions.source: A grand day here covers all five major sites; the tomb of Nefertari can be added on request, at an extra fee and subject to a permit.

customisationOptions.option: Add extra-ticket tombs such as KV62 and KV17
customisationOptions.source: If your party wants the deeper Theban argument we can pair this with a separate Karnak-and-Luxor-Temple East Bank day, or add the supplementary tickets for KV62 and KV17.

customisationOptions.option: Pair with a Karnak and Luxor Temple East Bank day
customisationOptions.source: If your party wants the deeper Theban argument we can pair this with a separate Karnak-and-Luxor-Temple East Bank day, or add the supplementary tickets for KV62 and KV17.

customisationOptions.option: Add a dawn balloon or go at a private pace
customisationOptions.source: If you want the extra-ticket tombs — Seti I, Ramses VI — a dawn balloon before the vans roll, or the same ground at a private pace, our concierge will build it into the morning.
